## Gramstax.cacheKeyboard property

In-memory cache for keyboard instances by language.

**Signature:**

```typescript
cacheKeyboard: Map<any, any>;
```

## Remarks

Cached values are built from [BlockKeyboard](./gramstax.blockkeyboard.md) and reused per language.
